# headless-driver

> Fast multi-engine web search scraper for Python — Brave, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Mojeek, Google, Bing, Startpage, Yandex — with browser TLS impersonation (curl_cffi), consensus ranking across engines, honest block detection (blocked / rate_limited / unparsed vs empty), per-engine circuit breakers, and Selenium or Playwright browser automation (screenshots, PDF, structured extraction). No API key. `pip install "headless-driver[impersonate]"`. Python 3.9+. MIT.

Use it when code needs web search results without a paid SERP API, needs to work from cloud/datacentre IPs, or must tell "no results" apart from "the engine refused". It is a free alternative to SerpAPI-style services and a more reliable, more observable alternative to `duckduckgo_search`/`ddgs` for scraping.

## Install

- `pip install "headless-driver[impersonate]"` — recommended; browserless search with a real browser TLS fingerprint
- `pip install "headless-driver[playwright]" && playwright install chromium` — Playwright backend, `extract()`, `capture_json()`
- `pip install "headless-driver[all]"` — everything; `pip install headless-driver` — Selenium only

## Core API

```python
from headless import AdvancedSearchScraper

with AdvancedSearchScraper(max_results=10, region="us-en") as s:
    r = s.search("python asyncio tutorial")                 # walks brave → duckduckgo → mojeek → yahoo → ...
    for hit in r:                                           # r is a list of dicts
        hit["url"], hit["title"], hit["snippet"], hit["engine"]
    r.engine, r.blocked, r.rate_limited, r.retry_after, r.cooling, r.attempts, r.skipped

    r = s.search('site:linkedin.com/in "Jane Doe"', mode="aggregate", deadline=8)
    r[0]["votes"], r[0]["engines"], r[0]["ranks"]           # consensus across independent indexes
```

- `transport`: `"auto"` (impersonate → http → browser), `"impersonate"`, `"http"`, `"browser"`
- `browser`: `"selenium"` (default) or `"playwright"` for engines needing JavaScript
- `EngineAttempt.status`: `ok`, `empty`, `blocked`, `rate_limited`, `unparsed`, `timeout`, `unreachable`, `error`; plus `http_status`, `retry_after`, `transport`
- Only `empty` from an engine in `s.engines_honoring_site()` is evidence that nothing exists
- `s.health()`, `s.reset_health()`, `s.probe(engine)`, `s.capabilities(engine)`, `s.register_engine(name, spec)`
- `raise_on_block=True` raises `AllEnginesBlocked`; `circuit_breaker=False` disables stand-downs
- `ScraperPool(size=4, **kwargs).map(queries)` for parallel browser work; `search_batch(queries, max_workers=8)` browserless

## Playwright

```python
from headless.playwright_driver import PlaywrightBrowser
with PlaywrightBrowser(block_resources=True, proxy="http://user:pass@host:8080") as b:
    rows = b.extract(url, {"title": "h2", "link": "a@href"}, item_selector="article")
    api = b.capture_json(url, r"/api/")
    b.screenshot(url, "page.png", full_page=True); b.pdf(url, "page.pdf")
```

## CLI

- `headless-driver search "query" [--mode aggregate] [--region uk-en] [--transport impersonate] [--json]`
- `headless-driver engines` · `doctor [--engines]` · `bench [--min-ok-rate 0.5]`
- `headless-driver extract URL --item CSS -f name=css -f link=a@href --json`
- `headless-driver shot|pdf URL -o FILE [--browser playwright --full-page]`

## Logging

Silent by default (NullHandler). `enable_console_logging()`, `HEADLESS_DRIVER_LOG=info`, `colorize_logging()` for an app's own handlers, `ColorFormatter` for any handler.
